dataset.distribution: Uniform unique valid1/2/3-clue inputs, excluding H3j/k/l/m/n/t N13 search keys. Target universe was already enumerated in H3t.

optimizer.objective: Exact full PL over all176 solutions and each of their298 one/two/three-clue subsets. Occupied free-cell multiplicity231, empty298; normalize by sum of free-cell counts. No target label or partial-input multiplicity used.
optimizer.calibration: Independent float64 reconstruction from final stored float32 source parameters: delta=min allsource/cell flip margin; tau=max source energy; unit=mean absolute source field. Equal complete-source multiplicity298 cancels in unit. Transfer all three scalars unchanged.
optimizer.eligibility: Require finite parameters, finite delta/tau/unit, unit>0 and delta>0. Any failed source-fit eligibility criterion falsifies the primary as source-fit failure: save fit evidence, do not retune, do not run optimizer target searches. All fixed controls still run.
